title: Support for s/mime certificates and encryption
creator: moz56
content:
Hi, I’ve been using Thunderbird Desktop for years with S/MIME encryption. Since S/MIME is not currently supported in Thunderbird Mobile, I can’t use it on my mobile device.

Is S/MIME support planned for a future release?

Thanks.
